goal: Disconnect HTTP clients that fail to finish sending a request within a deadline
Prevents slow or malicious clients from exhausting connection slots and blocking legitimate RPC access
agreement: Strong support with no open objections
Concept support noting it mitigates slow-loris attacks and bogus vulnerability reports (pinheadmz)
Support for the test structure with only a minor open style suggestion on string views (hodlinator)

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because unauthenticated clients can exhaust HTTP connection slots by trickling bytes indefinitely
Protects node operators from denial of service that causes tools like bitcoin-cli to hang indefinitely
